Landmark ruler (fixed for every garment; L/R = WEARER'S left/right; a point between two landmarks is written "A..B:t", t from 0 at A to 1 at B):
neck/shoulder: NP_x neck points (side of the neck, top of the shoulder line); SP_x shoulder tips; FSH_x/BSH_x mid-shoulder slightly front/back; CFN centre-front neck (crew height), CFN_LOW low front neck; CBN nape, CBN_LOW low back neck; NECK_SIDE_x base of the neck at the side (for collar stands);
torso: UA_x underarm (top of side seam); CHEST_x chest (pocket height), CHEST_C centre chest; BUST_C centre front under the bust; BUSTSIDE_x; SB_x shoulder blades; UB_C centre upper back; YOKE_x back yoke at the armhole; MB_x side at mid-back, MB_C centre back mid-back; WL_x waist at the side, WF_C/WB_C centre front/back waist; HIP_x hip at the side, HIP_C_F/HIP_C_B; HEM_x hem of a top at the side (hip length), HEM_FC/HEM_BC centre front/back hem;
tailoring: BREAK centre front where lapels meet (top button); LAPEL_TIP_x lapel point; GORGE_x the notch where collar meets lapel;
sleeves: SSLV_OUT_x/SSLV_IN_x short-sleeve end outer/inner; ELB_OUT_x/ELB_IN_x elbow; WRIST_OUT_x/WRIST_IN_x long-sleeve end outer/inner;
hood: HOOD_FRONT_x middle of the hood's front edge; HOOD_TOP top of the hood; HOOD_BACK back of the hood; HOOD_SIDE_x; HOOD_CROWN_F;
pockets: FPK_TOP_x/FPK_SIDE_x ends of a trouser front-pocket scoop; BPK_x back pocket centre; KANG_x/KANG_LOW_x corners of a kangaroo pocket;
lower body: CROTCH (inseam top), CROTCH_F/CROTCH_B; KNEE_OUT_x/KNEE_IN_x; ANKLE_OUT_x/ANKLE_IN_x; LEG_HEM_F_x/LEG_HEM_B_x middle of a leg hem front/back; SHORT_OUT_x/SHORT_IN_x/SHORT_HEM_F_x/SHORT_HEM_B_x shorts hem; SKIRT_HEM_x skirt hem at the side (knee), SKIRT_HEM_C_F/SKIRT_HEM_C_B.
Trousers/skirts start at the waist (WL_x, WF_C, WB_C); tops end at HEM_x or shorter (e.g. "UA_L..HEM_L:0.6").

LAYERS (depth levels; 0 = outermost):
- layer 0: outer body (front + lower back + straps) — SHEER. Sheer white rib jersey. Skin and the inner V layer show through it.
- layer 1: inner front V-panel / modesty lining — SHEER. A second layer behind the front, covering the upper chest. It is caught into the neckband and the armhole bindings at the top. Its lower edge is a free V with the point at about BUST_C. It shows only as a soft shadow line.
- layer 2: back panel — SHEER. Single layer from about mid-back down to the hem. It is the same cloth as the outer front and is joined to it at the side seams.

JOIN LIST (the construction; every view must agree with it):
- neckband_front: band (narrow) from NP_R → CFN → NP_L. continues into strap_L, strap_R. High crew neck finished at the front only. It runs into the crossed straps at the neck points.
- strap_L: strap (wide) from NP_L → UB_C → MB_R. continues into neckband_front, armhole_front_L, back_top_edge. Starts as the whole left shoulder (NP_L to SP_L width). It goes over the back, crosses the right strap at UB_C and ends at the right side, mid-back height, where it meets the back panel. Its edges are folded or bound.
- strap_R: strap (wide) from NP_R → UB_C → MB_L. continues into neckband_front, armhole_front_R, back_top_edge. Mirror of strap_L. Which strap lies on top at the cross is uncertain.
- armhole_front_L: binding (narrow) from SP_L → UA_L. continues into strap_L, side_seam_L. Cut-in front armhole, bound or turned. Its upper end continues into the strap's outer edge.
- armhole_front_R: binding (narrow) from SP_R → UA_R. continues into strap_R, side_seam_R. Mirror of armhole_front_L.
- armhole_back_L: edge from UA_L → MB_L. continues into strap_R, side_seam_L. Short back armhole edge below the underarm. It is formed by the outer edge of the lower end of strap_R.
- armhole_back_R: edge from UA_R → MB_R. continues into strap_L, side_seam_R. Mirror of armhole_back_L.
- back_top_edge: binding (narrow) from MB_R → MB_C → MB_L. continues into strap_L, strap_R. Shallow U-shaped top edge of the back panel, dipping slightly at MB_C. A small vertical tack or seam mark sits at MB_C.
- back_opening: OPENING (no cloth) bounded by strap_L, strap_R, back_top_edge. Large open back, from below the strap cross at UB_C down to MB_C.
- side_seam_L: seam from UA_L → WL_L → HEM_L. continues into armhole_front_L, hem_front, hem_back. Side seam, set slightly forward of the true side.
- side_seam_R: seam from UA_R → WL_R → HEM_R. continues into armhole_front_R, hem_front, hem_back. Visible in the side photo.
- hem_front: edge from HEM_L → HEM_FC → HEM_R. continues into side_seam_L, side_seam_R. Straight hem just below the waist. It is a narrow, slightly curling, raw-looking finish.
- hem_back: edge from HEM_R → HEM_BC → HEM_L. continues into side_seam_L, side_seam_R. Same finish as the front hem.
- inner_V_edge: edge from NP_L..SP_L:0.6 → BUST_C → NP_R..SP_R:0.6. Lower edge of the inner V-panel, seen as a shadow through the outer front. The point of the V is at the under-bust centre.
- inner_V_top: edge from NP_L..SP_L:0.6 → NP_L → CFN → NP_R → NP_R..SP_R:0.6. The top of the inner panel is caught into the neckband and the upper armhole/strap finish.
ABSENT (do not draw): no back neckline or back neck binding (the straps cross instead); no sleeves; no closures; no pockets; no centre-front seam; no shoulder seam visible; no back between the strap cross and mid-back (open)

CHECK EVERY VIEW AGAINST THESE BEFORE DRAWING:
- neckband_front: its top end sits AT the neck point NP_R, right beside the neck, only a neck-width away from neckband_front, NOT at the shoulder tip; nothing of it rises above the neckline.
- strap_R: its top end sits AT the neck point NP_R, right beside the neck, only a neck-width away from neckband_front, NOT at the shoulder tip; nothing of it rises above the neckline.
- neckband_front: its top end sits AT the neck point NP_L, right beside the neck, only a neck-width away from neckband_front, NOT at the shoulder tip; nothing of it rises above the neckline.
- strap_L: its top end sits AT the neck point NP_L, right beside the neck, only a neck-width away from neckband_front, NOT at the shoulder tip; nothing of it rises above the neckline.
- strap_L runs DIAGONALLY across the back from NP_L to MB_R on the OPPOSITE side, as one straight band.
- strap_R runs DIAGONALLY across the back from NP_R to MB_L on the OPPOSITE side, as one straight band.
- strap_L and strap_R cross each other once, BELOW the neck points (between the shoulder blades), never above the neckline.
- There is NO back neckline: neckband_front, inner_V_top runs across the FRONT only. On the FRONT view draw NOTHING behind or inside the front neck band (no back-neck arc, no second curve). On the BACK view draw NOTHING between the tops of the bands at the neck points — no neckline, no band, no line.
- armhole_front_L starts at SP_L and stops at UA_L; it does not continue past them.
- armhole_front_R starts at SP_R and stops at UA_R; it does not continue past them.
- back_top_edge starts at MB_R and stops at MB_L; it does not continue past them.
- The area bounded by strap_L, strap_R, back_top_edge is OPEN: leave it white — no cloth, no panel, no line across it.
- Draw NOTHING for: no back neckline or back neck binding (the straps cross instead).
- Draw NOTHING for: no sleeves.
- Draw NOTHING for: no closures.
- Draw NOTHING for: no pockets.
- Draw NOTHING for: no centre-front seam.
- Draw NOTHING for: no shoulder seam visible.
- Draw NOTHING for: no back between the strap cross and mid-back (open).
- inner_V_edge comes to a SHARP corner at BUST_C: a crisp point, never rounded.
- SIDE LEFT shows the wearer's LEFT flank with the front facing the LEFT edge of its frame; SIDE RIGHT is its mirror with the front facing the RIGHT edge.
- The sheer cloth is drawn exactly like opaque cloth: white, no grey, no hatching, no tint anywhere.
- inner_V_edge is the edge of the layer BEHIND the sheer front (inner front V-panel / modesty lining), seen through it: draw it as ONE fine dashed line, lighter than seams; it does not break or touch the outline; no tint, no fill on either side of it.
- inner_V_edge is a free hanging edge: it runs from NP_L..SP_L:0.6 to NP_R..SP_R:0.6 via BUST_C and does NOT run into the side seams or the hem.
- inner_V_top ends INTO neckband_front, armhole_front_L, armhole_front_R: at those points two edges meet — the outer body (front + lower back + straps)'s binding and the inner layer's edge just inside it. On the SIDE views this shows as a second fine line just inside the armhole binding at the shoulder, running down into the dashed V.
- Draw NOTHING for inner_V_top on any view (construction only).
- back_top_edge is ONE smooth U-shaped binding across the back at mid-back level, from MB_R down through MB_C and up to MB_L; the lower ends of the straps are sewn to it at its two top ends.
- In SIDE LEFT and SIDE RIGHT the strap is ONE smooth continuous band: from the front neck band up over the top of the shoulder and down the back to the back opening edge — no loop, knot, hook, fold or notch; behind the strap the back body starts only at mid-back height (open back), while the front body starts at the neck.
